title: Explicit hidden lists compile only into exact already-empty native children
steps: Index a plan explicitly hiding a slots list and run the complete write step against matching empty native child values.
Repeat with missing, nonempty, null, wrong-type and absent current values, unresolved definitions and competing kept or writer content.
Read back the hidden child values after reopening one, and compare populated paid plans before and after indexing.
expect: Exact declared children receive list provenance and live read-back, with no native child writes.
Any unresolved, mismatched or conflicting child blocks the whole list; nested concrete declarations compile and overlapping units do not.
Reopened children fail read-back. Existing paid plans and released contracts are not rewritten.
fence: explicit plan list hides plus exact declared children and live native empty values; no activation or inferred removal capability
